newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Foodland dips after Innerhaddden sale.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Foodland dips after Innerhaddden sale.

text.p: The shares of grocery wholesaler and retailer Foodland Associated Ltd fell sharply in early trade on Tuesday after the sale of a 6.5 percent stake in the company by investment group Innerhadden Ltd.
At 10.40 a.m. (0040 GMT), Foodland shares were 18 cents weaker at A$5.35 on volume of 7.27 million shares.
Innerhadden said earlier it had sold 6.812 million Foodland shares for about A$37.8 million.
"Based on trading in the two stocks since the announcement it would appear Foodland shares have fallen because of the sale," a Sydney-based dealer said.
At 10.55 a.m. (0055 GMT), Innerhadden shares were 10 cents higher at A$1.10 on turnover of just 3,000 shares.
Innerhadden said it recorded a pre-tax profit of A$7.15 million on the book value of its investment in Foodland.
The sale followed Innerhadden's disposal of its entire shareholding in Vision Systems Ltd, which generated a pre-tax profit A$1.5 million.
